From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@medix.com>

Cc: Legal Ops <legal@medix.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T10:12:00Z
Subject: Pricing and packaging for audit logs / HSM / EU residency

Hi Logan —

Thanks for taking this on. We're working up our procurement packet and need a clear pricing picture for Redwood's compliance add-ons so we can run an apples-to-apples comparison with other vendors. High-level asks below — can you confirm pricing ranges and any pack/bundle credit you can offer for an annual committed spend?

What we need priced:
- Audit logs: 1yr / 3yr / 7yr retention options, per-GB monthly charge + any retrieval fees for long-term retention.
- KMS / HSM integration: pricing for managed HSM seats (monthly) vs. integration-only (per-API-call or per-key fee). Onboarding/setup fees?
- Data residency: EU residency plus multi-region (US + EU) — what are the region premiums and lead times to enable EU for our org?
- HIPAA support: any additional costs or bundle you recommend for covered workloads (we'll need BAAs + SOC2 proof).

Context: Medix expects ~120 qps at peak for the first year (~150B tokens/year projected), initial pilot in the US with EU rollout in Q2. We're targeting a 12–18 month committed agreement (volume TBD but likely in the $600k–$1.2M ARR range depending on pricing). Legal will want a single-point quote with line-items for each compliance add-on.

Attached: our security questionnaire (redacted). Also include any standard SLA language you require for residency/HSM.

Timeline: if you can get back to us with a draft quote + proposed credits by EOD Thursday (2027-01-21), that would keep us on track for procurement review the following week.

Thanks —
Maria Sanchez
Head of Cloud Platforms, Medix Health
Attachments: Medix_Security_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@medix.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@medix.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing and packaging for audit logs / HSM / EU residency

Hi Maria —

Appreciate the details and the timeline. Quick read below; I'll follow up with an internal pricing worksheet and a draft quote.

Short answers up front:
- Audit logs: we support 1/3/7yr retention. Typical per-GB monthly band is $0.02 (1yr) / $0.015 (3yr) / $0.010 (7yr) with retrieval fees for cold storage beyond 30 days. We can discount storage on committed annual spend.
- HSM: Managed HSM seats are a $1,500/mo seat with a 3-seat minimum for enterprise plans; integration-only option is an API-key model (lower monthly, higher per-call cost). We can offer a one-time onboarding fee waiver or credit for larger commitments.
- Residency: EU region premium is typically +12–18% for stocked capacity; EU enablement lead time is 3–6 weeks if we can schedule capacity; Private/VPC options add lead time.
- HIPAA: BAA is available; SOC2 reports and most HIPAA artifacts are included with our enterprise compliance bundle (add-on).

A few clarifying Qs that change pricing materially: expected sustained concurrency, whether you require dedicated (Redwood Dedicated) or hosted with residency constraints, and if you need HSM vendor-certified modules (HSM model X vs. generic).

I've attached a preliminary pricing workbook so you can see the line-item math. I'll pull together a concession framework and recommended bundle to present to Ben/Grace for sign-off.

Next step: internal review and proposal delivered by Thu EOD.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: prelim_pricing_workbook.xlsx

Folks — forwarding Medix's asks and my initial suggested posture. Need sign-off on the concession framework before I send the formal quote.

Quoted ask (high level): 120 qps peak, EU rollout in Q2, 1yr commitment target (likely moves to 12–18 month committed ARR ~$600k–$1.2M). Key add-ons: audit logs (7yr desired), managed HSM (3 seats), EU residency + HIPAA/BAA.

Proposed commercial construct (recommended):
- Base: Hosted API pricing for compute + embeddings per token (standard list).
- Compliance bundle (optional add-on):
  - Audit logs: tiered per-GB/month: 1yr=$0.02, 3yr=$0.015, 7yr=$0.01. Retrieval fee: $0.005/GB after 30d for archive.
  - HSM seats: $1,500/mo/seat with 3-seat minimum OR integration-only with $0.0005/KS call.
  - Residency premium: +15% on base compute for EU region capacity; enablement lead-time 3–6 weeks.
  - HIPAA + SOC2 bundle: one-line add-on at $35k/yr for enterprise pack (includes BAA, attestation stack access).

Concession strategy (what we give Medix to win):
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-year committed spend (applied to audit-log storage or onboarding fees), capped at $50k.
- If they commit >= $750k ARR and a 12-month prepay, increase storage discount by an additional 8% on the first year (effectively deeper per-GB discount).
- For HSM seats: waive first-month seat fees for up to 3 seats; for integration-only customers, provide $10k credit toward integration engineering time.

Operational caveats / POs:
- We should include a clear SLA for residency (planned 99.9% for hosted with regional failover; Dedicated can have higher SLA but requires a separate contract).
- Lead times are estimates; push for an explicit committed start date in SOW.

Grace — product confirmation: are the HSM seat rates and residency premium above accurate given current capacity? Karthik — can you confirm if the 10% onboarding credit needs additional legal approval for finance?

If we approve, I will:
1) Draft a line-item quote and SOW with the concession language.
2) Include a timeline for EU enablement and HSM onboarding (proposed 6 weeks from PO receipt).
3) Send to Maria with a follow-up call booked to walk through the quote.

Thanks —
Logan
